continuous_source_distance.method: Deterministic exposed envelope face samples to nearest original continuous input triangle
continuous_source_distance.scope: Inferred exterior envelope fidelity; not final part-surface or perceptual accuracy. One LDU is0.4mm.

exterior_extraction.method: triangle-box SAT, padded exterior flood-fill, bounded morphological closing

fitting.note: Slope geometry removes material within its reserved rectangular envelope; cell coverage is bookkeeping, not exact solid geometry equality.
fitting.strategy: bounded slope shoulders, smooth exposed tiles, greedy shell bricks/plates

provenance.source_fidelity_note: Orthographic silhouettes against source triangle raster at the selected pitch; not a continuous-surface or perceptual resemblance score.
warnings: The exterior envelope is inferred from sampled geometry; a one-cell closing may bridge small gaps.
Open sheets and separate source components can remain mechanically disconnected.
Interior mesh interfaces are removed where enclosed; source textures/materials are ignored.
